description: This file defines the ForbiddenException class which extends the built-in PHP Exception class and implements the ValidationEscapableException interface. It is used for handling authorization-related errors within the OrangeHRM API version 2, specifically representing forbidden access scenarios.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: Custom exception class used when an API request is forbidden, indicating unauthorized access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new ForbiddenException with an optional custom message, error code, and previous exception.
